title: Which of the person's open tabs is the one they are using
description: PUT /api/v1/account/active-device. Each open tab of the person reports whether it is visible and how long ago it last had keyboard, pointer or touch input; the reply says whether the attention sound plays in that tab. The person's own daemon keeps the reports in memory only, so a tab never learns about another person's tabs. The tab with the freshest input within five minutes plays; when no tab has had input for that long, every tab plays.

tab.description: A random identifier the tab chose for itself when it opened. It names nothing else.

idle_ms.description: Milliseconds since the tab's last input; absent while it has had none. The daemon reads it against its own clock, so the devices' clocks need not agree.

left.description: The tab is closing: it is forgotten at once.

play.description: Whether the attention sound plays in the reporting tab now.
